values.name: AuthoredCommand
values.doc: AuthoredCommand is a workflow command (set-output, save-state, set-env or add-path) whose name is in the text of a run of bash or sh and that the run prints to its log (taint.AuthoredCommand).

fields.name: Command
fields.doc: the command

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the name in the run

values.name: AutomaticApproval
values.doc: AutomaticApproval is how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler on an attacker's pull request lets a labeled run of the job in (actions/labeler): the automatic labels, the label, where the token of the step comes from, the step, and the environment of the job.

fields.name: AutomaticLabels
fields.doc: AutomaticLabelFree alone, or the conditions that leave it undecided; none when no labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: LabelNames
fields.doc: the labels of the configuration that let the run in, in the order of their names; none when the attacker writes the configuration or it is not known

fields.name: Token
fields.doc: where the token of the labeler comes from, which decides the actor of the labeled run

fields.name: Environment
fields.doc: the environment of the job, written out, when AutomaticLabels is AutomaticLabelFree: it approves the run when it has required reviewers

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the step of the labeler, in its workflow

values.name: CacheSaveStep
values.doc: CacheSaveStep is a step that saves to the cache what a checkout brings (actions/prcode).

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: the step's name, else steps[<n>]

fields.name: Step
fields.doc: the step, as its CacheSave names it

fields.name: Action
fields.doc: actions/cache, which saves at the end of the job, or actions/cache/save

fields.name: Line
fields.doc: the line of its path that has the tree, as written

fields.name: Known
fields.doc: whether the line is known: false when a ${{ }} that is not the workspace's decides it

fields.name: SaveOn
fields.doc: of the site's cacheWriteOn, the events the step's if lets through: those on which it saves the tree

fields.name: Via
fields.doc: for a step of a composite action that a step of the job runs (actions/composite), the uses from that step to the action the cache step is of, that action's last; none for a step of the job

fields.name: Substituted
fields.doc: whether the action the step is of has a file in the archive the runner downloads unlike its blob (export-subst), whose content may change after the run

fields.name: At
fields.doc: its path, else its with; for a step of a composite action, the uses of the step of the job that runs the action

fields.name: PathAt
fields.doc: for a step of a composite action, its path, else its with, in the file it is written in (an input, or the value of action.definition); zero for a step of the job

values.name: CalledJob
values.doc: CalledJob is a job of a reusable workflow of another repository that a job of the input calls (actions/composite.Reader.ExpandCall): the labels of its runs-on and its cache-mode.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc: the ID of the job, as written

fields.name: Chain
fields.doc: the uses from the calling job to the workflow the job is of, that workflow's last

fields.name: Query
fields.doc: the workflow.definition whose value is the file the job is written in

fields.name: RunnerLabels
fields.doc: the labels of its runs-on

fields.name: InconclusiveLabels
fields.doc: the labels of its runs-on that are inconclusive

fields.name: CacheModeText
fields.doc: its cache-mode as written; empty when it writes none

fields.name: CacheModeAt
fields.doc: its cache-mode, else the job

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the job, in the file it is written in

values.name: CallsNotRead
values.doc: CallsNotRead is the first call of a function whose body the readings of a run did not read past their limit of calls.

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where the call is

values.name: CapabilityGrant
values.doc: CapabilityGrant is a capability a permission of a step of an agent action gives its agent (actions/agent): through the permission alone, or with an edit of the workspace (Partner) whose code the permitted command runs.

fields.name: Capability
fields.doc: what it lets the agent do

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input the permission is in; unset for one the action allows on its own

fields.name: Permission
fields.doc: the permission as written, or as the action writes it

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the permission in its input, the input's value, or the uses

fields.name: Partner
fields.doc: the permission to edit whose edits the permitted command runs; empty when there is none

fields.name: PartnerAt
fields.doc: where Partner is

values.name: CarriedSecret
values.doc: CarriedSecret is a secret a request carries (actions/taint): by name, the job's token, or the whole secrets context.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: the secret's name as written; empty for the job's token

fields.name: Token
fields.doc: the job's token: secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN or github.token

fields.name: Whole
fields.doc: the whole secrets context: toJSON(secrets), secrets[x]

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where the request takes it: the ${{ }}, the variable, or the command for gh api's enterprise token; none for an action's

values.name: CheckoutRef
values.doc: CheckoutRef is a reference to a pull request's code in the with of a checkout.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input it is in

fields.name: Mutable
fields.doc: a branch's name, or a ref GitHub moves

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: CodeRunStep
values.doc: CodeRunStep is a step after a checkout that runs the code it brings.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: the step's name, else steps[<n>]

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the command or the uses, as written

fields.name: Cite
fields.doc: the https URL of why the row of the table runs code of the tree

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the command in the run, else the uses, else the step

values.name: CommandArgument
values.doc: CommandArgument is a word of a simple command of a run of bash or sh with a value an attacker may control in it, and how the command reads the word (actions/taint).

fields.name: Command
fields.doc: the command and its subcommands, such as git fetch

fields.name: Known
fields.doc: the table of commands has the command

fields.name: Word
fields.doc: the index of the word among the command's words

fields.name: OptionPlace
fields.doc: the command may read as an option a word the value starts: the word, at the place of options, and the value at its head; or, for a value outside quotes that can hold blanks, a word it splits into

fields.name: Undecided
fields.doc: the word before it is an option the table of commands does not declare, which may take it as its value

fields.name: Runs
fields.doc: the command declares an option that runs a program: one seen to in an attacker's spelling, or one read as code or a program

fields.name: Spelled
fields.doc: the options seen to run a program in a spelling the attacker can write with this value, as they write them: a long option with = for one word (--to-command=), a short option alone for one word or two (-e, -c); an option whose program runs on the remote side only when the command names a repository on a local path, where the program runs on the runner

fields.name: Remote
fields.doc: an option seen to run a program on the remote side can be written, and the command names no repository on a local path nor one of HTTPS: the program runs on the remote host of an SSH remote, or where the repository decides at run time

fields.name: RemoteSSH
fields.doc: with Remote: the command names an SSH remote, where the program runs on the remote host

fields.name: RepoName
fields.doc: every value that may begin with - is the name of a repository, which holds only ASCII letters, digits, ., - and _: the attacker writes only a short option with its value joined in one word

fields.name: Unverified
fields.doc: a spelling the attacker can write is, for an option that runs a program, seen neither to run it nor not to

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the reference: the ${{ }}, or what env gives the variable

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the context path of the reference, such as github.head_ref: of the ${{ }}, or of the reference in the env value, the same before and after a fix moves the ${{ }} into env

fields.name: LeadingDash
fields.doc: the events on which an attacker can make the value begin with -

fields.name: DashUndecided
fields.doc: the events, not of LeadingDash, on which whether an attacker can make the value begin with - is not known

fields.name: Head
fields.doc: the value is at the head of the word

fields.name: Blanks
fields.doc: an attacker can write blanks in the value: one of the events is one on which they write it freely

fields.name: Quoted
fields.doc: the word is inside quotes

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the ${{ }} or the variable in the run

values.name: CompositeAction
values.doc: CompositeAction is an action a step runs, or that a step of a composite action it runs runs, to the depth composite.Reader reads (actions/composite): an action.yml of the inputs, or the file action.definition answers for an action of another repository.

fields.name: Chain
fields.doc: the uses from the step to the action, its own last

fields.name: File
fields.doc: the file that defines the action, as action.definition answers; unset for an input

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input the action is; zero for an action of another repository

fields.name: Query
fields.doc: the action.definition whose value is the file of the action; nil for an input

fields.name: Substituted
fields.doc: whether the archive the runner downloads has the file of the action unlike its blob (export-subst), so that the content may change after the run

fields.name: Images
fields.doc: the runs.image of a Docker container action as written after docker://, when it is an image (not a Dockerfile); none for another action

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the root of the file of the action; zero for a Dockerfile

values.name: CompositeStep
values.doc: CompositeStep is a step of a composite action that a step runs, to the depth composite.Reader reads (actions/composite).

fields.name: UsesText
fields.doc: the uses of the step as written; empty for a run

fields.name: Repo
fields.doc: owner/repo of the uses when the uses names another repository, as written; else empty

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the path of the action of the uses in that repository, as the runner reads it; empty at the root, and when the uses names no other repository

fields.name: RunUses
fields.doc: each reading of the action that the uses runs, as owner/repo[/path]@ref with the path as the runner reads it, as the field runUses of a Uses has; empty when the uses names no other repository

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the ref of the uses as written; empty when the uses names no other repository

fields.name: Chain
fields.doc: the uses from the calling step to the action the step is of, that action's last

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input the step is written in; zero for a step of an action of another repository

fields.name: Query
fields.doc: the action.definition whose value is the file the step is written in; nil for an input

fields.name: Substituted
fields.doc: whether the archive the runner downloads has the file the step is written in unlike its blob (export-subst), so that the step may change after the run

fields.name: Images
fields.doc: the image of a uses: docker:// as written after docker://; none for another step

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the step, in the file it is written in

values.name: DependabotBypass
values.doc: DependabotBypass is a comparison of an if that a run of Dependabot lets through.

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the reference compared, as written

fields.name: Literal
fields.doc: the string or number it is compared with

fields.name: Replacement
fields.doc: the context of the author of the pull request in its place (the fix's), empty when there is none

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the reference

values.name: EnvironmentFileWrite
values.doc: EnvironmentFileWrite is what a run writes to an environment file.

fields.name: File
fields.doc: the file command

fields.name: Side
fields.doc: where on the line it is written

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: what is written, as written

fields.name: RefIndex
fields.doc: of the refs of the sink; -1 when Var is the variable written

fields.name: Var
fields.doc: when Ref is -1: the variable written

fields.name: Reach
fields.doc: the events on which an attacker writes with it what the runner reads as their own: a name, or a directory of $GITHUB_PATH

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

fields.name: start
fields.doc: in the value, for the plan

values.name: EveryRunRef
values.doc: EveryRunRef is a reference that reaches the agent of a step of an agent action and whose value the attacker chooses in every run, whoever starts the run: a variable or a secret, in a run of an attacker who writes vars or secrets.

fields.name: Route
fields.doc: an input written into the prompt, an env of the step, a setting input, or an input of a composite action of another repository whose step runs the agent

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input, by the route of an input

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: the name of the env, by the route of an env

fields.name: CompositeInput
fields.doc: the input of the composite action that the with of the step gives, by the route of an input of a composite action; the zero InputName when the with is a ${{ }} as a whole

fields.name: Composite
fields.doc: the uses of the step that uses the composite action, as written, by the route of an input of a composite action

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the reference

fields.name: EveryRunOn
fields.doc: the EveryRunOn of the reference, of the events the action runs on

fields.name: Source
fields.doc: the reference of vars or secrets the value comes from, as one string (expr.PathString), such as vars.NAME; empty when the value does not come from one reference of vars or secrets

fields.name: SourceName
fields.doc: the name of the variable or the secret of Source, as written; empty when Source is empty

fields.name: SourceSecret
fields.doc: whether Source is a reference of secrets, not of vars

fields.name: Direct
fields.doc: whether the reference is Source itself, not a reference of env or inputs whose value comes from Source

values.name: ExprRef
values.doc: ExprRef is a ${{ }} reference in a run or a script, or the value a variable written to a file command has.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written

fields.name: Verdict
fields.doc: whether an attacker controls it

fields.name: ControlledOn
fields.doc: when Controlled: those on which an attacker controls it

fields.name: InconclusiveKind
fields.doc: when Inconclusive: why

fields.name: QuotedJSON
fields.doc: toJson(...) as the whole ${{ }}, in the body of a bash or sh heredoc whose delimiter is quoted and cannot be a line toJson writes

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: where each env it went through gets its value, the first first

fields.name: With
fields.doc: inputs.x: the with of the callers (or the input's default) it came through, the outermost caller's first; in the inputs they are of

fields.name: OtherCallers
fields.doc: inputs.x: the with of each other caller that gives it what an attacker controls

fields.name: part
fields.doc: of the parts of the value, for the plan

values.name: GapCredential
values.doc: GapCredential is a step before an upload that leaves a credential whose taking a gap of the upload decides (actions/artifact).

fields.name: File
fields.doc: the file the step leaves the credential in

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the step

values.name: Image
values.doc: Image is an image to run, as written, or a value of the matrix a whole ${{ matrix.<name> }} takes.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the image as written, without docker://

fields.name: Tag
fields.doc: its tag; empty when it has none

fields.name: Pinned
fields.doc: whether a digest pins it

fields.name: Matrix
fields.doc: whether it is a value of the matrix

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is written

values.name: InconclusiveImage
values.doc: InconclusiveImage is an image that is a ${{ }} the analysis cannot read as values written in the matrix: inconclusive.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written

fields.name: Dispatch
fields.doc: whether the ${{ }} has an input of workflow_dispatch (inputs, github.event.inputs): whoever dispatches the workflow chooses the image

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: InconclusiveLabel
values.doc: InconclusiveLabel is a label of runs-on that is a ${{ }} the analysis cannot read as values written in the matrix: inconclusive.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written

fields.name: Dispatch
fields.doc: whether the ${{ }} has an input of workflow_dispatch (inputs, github.event.inputs): whoever dispatches the workflow chooses the label

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: InconclusiveSetting
values.doc: InconclusiveSetting is an input of a step of an agent action the analysis does not read: a ${{ }}, or a settings that names a file.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: a gate or a setting

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input; unset when the whole with is a ${{ }}

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written

fields.name: UndecidedOn
fields.doc: for a gate: the events of the step's actorOn on which whom it lets in is not decided; none for a setting

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: InconclusiveUpload
values.doc: InconclusiveUpload is an input of an upload whose analysis is inconclusive.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: an input of the upload, or of a step that leaves a credential

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the input and its value, as written

fields.name: Files
fields.doc: the files of the credentials whose leaving, or whose taking by the upload, its value decides

fields.name: Credentials
fields.doc: of a gap of the upload: the steps before the upload that leave a credential whose taking its value decides, in their order

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: InconclusiveWrite
values.doc: InconclusiveWrite is a write to an environment file whose analysis is inconclusive.

fields.name: File
fields.doc: the file command

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: why it is inconclusive

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: InheritCaller
values.doc: InheritCaller is a job of the inputs that calls a workflow with secrets: inherit.

fields.name: Caller
fields.doc: the file the job is in: an input, or a remote called workflow

fields.name: Job
fields.doc: the job's ID, for the note of a related location

fields.name: At
fields.doc: its secrets

values.name: LaterStep
values.doc: LaterStep is a step that may run after a step of an agent action has started, or beside it (actions/agent): what it holds that the agent does not, and where it runs what the agent may leave.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: the step's name, else steps[<n>]

fields.name: On
fields.doc: of the agent step's attackerOn, and of the events of its everyRunRefs, the events its if lets through

fields.name: Secrets
fields.doc: the names of the secrets it reads that the agent does not hold

fields.name: AllSecrets
fields.doc: whether it reads secrets whose names it does not write out, and the agent does not

fields.name: Token
fields.doc: whether it reads the job's token, which the agent does not hold

fields.name: CodeRuns
fields.doc: where it runs the code of the agent's working directory

fields.name: GitRuns
fields.doc: where it starts git

fields.name: At
fields.doc: its run, else its uses, else the step

values.name: LogWrite
values.doc: LogWrite is a reference an attacker may control that a run of bash or sh prints to its log, set -x included (actions/taint).

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the reference as written: the ${{ }}'s reference, or the variable

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the reference the value comes from: the context's path, also through env, which the fix of code-injection keeps

fields.name: RefIndex
fields.doc: of the refs of the sink; -1 when Var is the variable printed

fields.name: Var
fields.doc: when RefIndex is -1: the variable printed

fields.name: Commands
fields.doc: the events on which an attacker writes a workflow command of the runner in it: ##[set-env ...] or ##[set-output ...] anywhere in a line, or ::set-env or ::set-output after a line break

fields.name: CommandsUndecided
fields.doc: the events on which whether an attacker writes one is not known: a structured value not checked

fields.name: PathCommands
fields.doc: the events on which an attacker writes an add-path command in it, of a value that holds no command that takes a property (set-env, set-output): the name of a wiki page

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: MissingCommit
values.doc: MissingCommit is a commit a pinned uses has to lack for a finding to hold (git.commit-contains false).

fields.name: Repo
fields.doc: the repository of the uses

fields.name: SHA
fields.doc: the commit it is pinned to

fields.name: Commit
fields.doc: the commit it has to lack

values.name: OpenGate
values.doc: OpenGate is a gate a step of an agent action opens (actions/agent): whom it lets start the agent past the action's check of the actor.

fields.name: Gate
fields.doc: whom it lets in

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input that opens it; unset when the action checks no actor

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the input's value as written; empty when the action checks no actor

fields.name: OpenOn
fields.doc: the events of the step's actorOn on which it lets the attacker in: all of them for '*' and for an action that checks no actor, else those on which its ${{ }} is their login (attacker.Table.ActorListed)

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the input's value, or the uses

values.name: OtherBot
values.doc: OtherBot is a comparison of an actor with a bot other than Dependabot, in an if.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the reference and the bot it is compared with

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the comparison

values.name: PRRunRef
values.doc: PRRunRef is what makes a download take the artifact of a run an attacker drives.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: as written: a context, allow_forks, or the uses

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input it is in, or the uses

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: PromptRef
values.doc: PromptRef is a ${{ }} reference in a value of a step of an agent action that reaches the agent as text (actions/agent): an input written into its prompt, or an env of the step.

fields.name: Route
fields.doc: an input or an env

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input, by the route of an input

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: the env's name, by the route of an env

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the reference

fields.name: On
fields.doc: when Controlled: those of its events the action runs on

fields.name: OthersOn
fields.doc: of On: those on which a run whose actor is not the attacker, in which it is theirs, gets past the ifs (attacker.Table.KeptOthers)

fields.name: EveryRunOn
fields.doc: of the EveryRunOn of the reference (taint.ExprRef.EveryRunOn), those the action runs on, not only the privileged events: the events on which the attacker chooses the value in every run, whoever starts the run; none but in a run of an attacker who writes vars or secrets

values.name: RequestRef
values.doc: RequestRef is a value an attacker may control in the destination of a request (actions/taint).

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the context path of the reference, the same before and after a fix moves its ${{ }} into env

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the reference: the ${{ }}, or what env gives the variable

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the ${{ }} or the variable in the run

values.name: RequestSite
values.doc: RequestSite is a request a simple command of a run of bash or sh sends to one of its destinations: curl, wget or gh api (actions/taint).

fields.name: Command
fields.doc: curl, wget or gh api

fields.name: Occurrence
fields.doc: the n-th request of the same command in the run, from 1

fields.name: HostRefs
fields.doc: the values an attacker may control before the path of its destination, where a value can end the authority and write its own host

fields.name: PathRefs
fields.doc: the values an attacker may control in the path, query or fragment of its destination

fields.name: Secrets
fields.doc: the secrets it carries to its destination; not a secret at the place of the host, which names the destination

fields.name: EnterpriseToken
fields.doc: gh api with GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN or GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN in env, which it sends to any host not of GitHub

fields.name: Destination
fields.doc: where the host of its destination comes from

fields.name: DestinationHost
fields.doc: when DestinationLiteral: the host, lower case, without the port

fields.name: DestinationPath
fields.doc: when DestinationNamed: the context path, such as secrets.UPLOAD_API

fields.name: DestinationRef
fields.doc: when DestinationNamed: the path read as a value an attacker may control

fields.name: RunnerHosting
fields.doc: who runs the machine of its job, by the job's runs-on; unknown in an action.yml

fields.name: RunnerLabels
fields.doc: the labels of the job's runs-on, as written

fields.name: ServiceNames
fields.doc: the names of the services of its job

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the destination's word in the run

fields.name: CommandAt
fields.doc: the command's word in the run

values.name: RunnerLabel
values.doc: RunnerLabel is a label of the runs-on of a job: as written, or a value of the matrix a whole ${{ matrix.<name> }} takes.

fields.name: Label
fields.doc: the label, trimmed where GitHub trims it

fields.name: HasSelfHostedLabel
fields.doc: whether it is the label every self-hosted runner has

fields.name: Matrix
fields.doc: whether it is a value of the matrix

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is written

values.name: SameRunUpload
values.doc: SameRunUpload is an upload of the current run, in a job that checks out the code of a pull request before the upload, whose artifact a download of the current run takes.

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: jobs.<id> of the job that uploads

fields.name: CheckoutAt
fields.doc: the step that checks out the code of the pull request

fields.name: UploadAt
fields.doc: the step that uploads

fields.name: Unless
fields.doc: the commits of the guard of actions/checkout, for a checkout pinned to a commit in no table: the upload holds the code of the pull request unless the commit has one of them

values.name: SecretLeak
values.doc: SecretLeak is a value the shell made from a secret, which the runner does not mask, where a run prints it to its log (actions/taint).

fields.name: Secret
fields.doc: the secret's name as written; empty for the job's token

fields.name: Token
fields.doc: the job's token: secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN or github.token

fields.name: Place
fields.doc: where the run prints it

fields.name: Transform
fields.doc: how the shell changed the value: the operator of an expansion, or the command

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the value in the run: the variable, the $( ), the command

fields.name: Command
fields.doc: the command that prints or writes it

values.name: SecretPartVia
values.doc: SecretPartVia is an output of a job that a value taken out of a secret comes through, which a later job reads with needs.

fields.name: Job
fields.doc: the job's ID as written, for the note of a related location

fields.name: Output
fields.doc: the output's name as written

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the ${{ }} of the output

values.name: Secrets
values.doc: Secrets are the secrets a job reads (actions/job): by name, GITHUB_TOKEN not among them, or All when it reads secrets whose names it does not write out.

fields.name: All
fields.doc: toJSON(secrets), secrets[x], or secrets: inherit to a reusable workflow that reads them so, or whose contents the linter does not have

fields.name: Names
fields.doc: the names it reads, as first written

values.name: SettingRef
values.doc: SettingRef is a ${{ }} reference in a value of a setting input of a step of an agent action, whose words or JSON set what the agent may do (actions/agent).

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: the reference

fields.name: On
fields.doc: when Controlled: those of its events the action runs on

fields.name: OthersOn
fields.doc: of On: those on which a run whose actor is not the attacker, in which it is theirs, gets past the ifs (attacker.Table.KeptOthers)

fields.name: EveryRunOn
fields.doc: of the EveryRunOn of the reference (taint.ExprRef.EveryRunOn), those the action runs on, not only the privileged events: the events on which the attacker chooses the value in every run, whoever starts the run; none but in a run of an attacker who writes vars or secrets

values.name: StartMode
values.doc: StartMode is the permission mode Claude Code starts in on the runs of a step of claude-code-action or its base-action (actions/agent).

fields.name: Mode
fields.doc: the mode, or why it is not decided

fields.name: Source
fields.doc: what decides an auto or a plan mode, as written

fields.name: On
fields.doc: the events of the runs it starts in the mode: those of the agent mode, and of the tag mode when a --permission-mode of claude_args wins over the tag mode's

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the input that decides it, or the uses

values.name: SubstringBypass
values.doc: SubstringBypass is a call of contains, startsWith or endsWith of a string and a reference in an if that a part of a value passes: a part of the string, or, with the reference first, a value with the string as a part.

fields.name: Func
fields.doc: the function, as written

fields.name: Literal
fields.doc: the string

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the reference, as written

fields.name: ReferenceFirst
fields.doc: the reference is the first argument: a value with the string as a part passes

fields.name: Fits
fields.doc: ReferenceFirst, and the string has the form of the attacker's value of the reference, so == of the two is a comparison some value passes

fields.name: Standalone
fields.doc: the call is the whole if, in parentheses, or an operand of && or ||, where == can stand in its place

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the call

values.name: TakenCredential
values.doc: TakenCredential is a LeftCredential an upload takes (actions/artifact).

fields.name: Index
fields.doc: of the LeftCredentials of the IR, in their order

fields.name: Hidden
fields.doc: whether the upload takes the file only as a hidden file, on the condition of the upload's hiddenMissingCommits

values.name: UnansweredCall
values.doc: UnansweredCall is a uses of another repository, on the way from a step of the job, whose action.definition someone asked could not answer (an unknown of --online, or of a file of facts that records one): what it runs may save the tree to the cache (actions/prcode).

fields.name: Via
fields.doc: the uses from the step of the job to the uses with no answer, the uses with no answer last

fields.name: Reason
fields.doc: why there is no answer, as the answer says

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the uses of the step of the job

values.name: UnansweredUses
values.doc: UnansweredUses is a uses of another repository, on the way from a step, whose action.definition has no answer (actions/composite).

fields.name: Chain
fields.doc: the uses from the step to the unanswered uses, the unanswered uses last, with no commit

fields.name: Asked
fields.doc: whether someone asked could not answer (an unknown of --online, or of a file of facts that records one); false when no one answered

fields.name: Reason
fields.doc: why there is no answer, as the answer says

values.name: UndecidedPermission
values.doc: UndecidedPermission is a permission of a step of an agent action, or an input of them, whose capabilities the analysis does not decide (actions/agent).

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: why

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input; unset for the whole with

fields.name: Permission
fields.doc: the permission or the input as written

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is

values.name: UnsafeSetting
values.doc: UnsafeSetting is a setting of a step of an agent action that takes a layer of the agent's sandbox off.

fields.name: Layer
fields.doc: what it takes off

fields.name: Input
fields.doc: the input

fields.name: Value
fields.doc: the word of its value that takes the layer off

fields.name: At
fields.doc: the input's value

values.name: VariableCode
values.doc: VariableCode is a variable of env, or one the runner writes, whose value an attacker may control and that a run of bash reads as code (taint.VariableCode).

fields.name: Text
fields.doc: the variable as written: $NAME, ${NAME...}, or a name without $ in arithmetic

fields.name: Path
fields.doc: the reference the value comes from: the context's path in the value of env, or the context of the variable the runner writes

fields.name: Reading
fields.doc: how bash or the program reads the value as code

fields.name: Ref
fields.doc: what env gives the variable, and whether an attacker controls it

fields.name: At
fields.doc: where it is in the run

summaries.name: AgentStep
summaries.doc: AgentStep is the summary of a step of an action that runs an AI agent (actions/agent): whom it lets start the agent, the settings that take a layer of its sandbox off, the events an attacker reaches it on, and what its permissions let the agent do.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: the action

fields.name: openGates
fields.doc: the gates it opens

fields.name: unsafeSettings
fields.doc: its settings that take a layer off

fields.name: inconclusiveSettings
fields.doc: its inputs the analysis does not read

fields.name: actorOn
fields.doc: the privileged events an attacker triggers themselves, as the actor, that the step runs on: those whose ifs, read with the attacker as the actor, let them in (attacker.Table.KeptActor), of those the action runs on

fields.name: attackerOn
fields.doc: the privileged events the step runs on whose payload has what an attacker wrote: those whose ifs some attacker run passes (taint.Filter), of those the action runs on

fields.name: promptRefs
fields.doc: the references of its values that reach the agent as text

fields.name: promptDispatch
fields.doc: whether a reference of promptRefs is an input of workflow_dispatch and the step can run on workflow_dispatch past its ifs

fields.name: othersOn
fields.doc: of attackerOn: those on which a run whose actor is not the attacker, whose payload has what they wrote, gets past the ifs (attacker.Table.KeptOthers)

fields.name: capabilityGrants
fields.doc: what its permissions let the agent do

fields.name: undecidedPermissions
fields.doc: its permissions whose capabilities are not decided

fields.name: settingRefs
fields.doc: the references of the values of its setting inputs

fields.name: writtenValueOn
fields.doc: the events of the step, of those the action runs on, on which a value that the attacker writes for every workflow run, a variable or a secret, may reach the step (taint.StepValue.WrittenValueOn); for a step of a composite action of another repository, the events on which the with of the step that uses the action may give such a value (taint.ValuePartOn) to an input that may reach a reference of the prompt of the step, kept by the ifs of the steps of the composite action: an input that the prompt of the step refers to (directly or through an env of the step), or any input when the with is one ${{ }}, when the prompt has a value (directly or through an env of the step) that is not analyzed and is not an input, or when the step is in an action that the used action runs. None but in a run of an attacker who writes vars or secrets

fields.name: everyRunRefs
fields.doc: the references of promptRefs and settingRefs whose EveryRunOn is not empty

fields.name: agentUser
fields.doc: whom its agent's process runs as

fields.name: runnerSudo
fields.doc: whether its job's runs-on is of GitHub-hosted Linux or macOS runners, whose user has passwordless sudo; false in an action metadata file

fields.name: gitWrite
fields.doc: whether its agent's edits may write .git

fields.name: autoMode
fields.doc: whether claude starts in auto mode: undecided when a ${{ }} sets the mode or decides the subprocess env scrub

fields.name: scrubDecides
fields.doc: whether a ${{ }} that decides claude's subprocess env scrub leaves open what its agent may do: a mode the scrub keeps in the default mode, or the tag mode's acceptEdits (agent.ScrubDecides)

fields.name: startModes
fields.doc: the mode claude starts in on its runs: none for other actions

fields.name: laterSteps
fields.doc: the steps of its job or action that may run after it has started, or beside it

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of its labeled runs, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

fields.name: chain
fields.doc: for a step of a composite action of another repository that a step of the input runs (actions/composite), the uses from that step to the action; at is then the uses of the step of the input, and the other handles are in the file of the action (the value of action.definition); none for a step of the input

fields.name: substituted
fields.doc: whether the archive the runner downloads has the file of that action unlike its blob (export-subst), so that the step may change after the run; false for a step of the input

fields.name: innerAt
fields.doc: for a step of a composite action of another repository, the step in the file of the action; zero for a step of the input

summaries.name: CacheRestoreSave
summaries.doc: CacheRestoreSave is the summary of a step that may save to the cache, under a new key, what a step of its job, or itself, restored from another key by restore-keys: actions/cache with restore-keys, or actions/cache/save after actions/cache/restore with restore-keys.

handles.name: restoreAt
handles.doc: the step that restores: the same step for actions/cache

fields.name: action
fields.doc: actions/cache, which saves at the end of the job on a miss, or actions/cache/save

fields.name: separate
fields.doc: whether the restore is another step than the save

fields.name: savesOn
fields.doc: the events of the workflow on which the job and both steps may run and the job may save to the cache

fields.name: saveText
fields.doc: the uses of the step that saves, as written

fields.name: chain
fields.doc: for actions/cache with restore-keys in a composite action of another repository that a step of the job runs (actions/composite), the uses from that step to the action; saveAt is then the uses of the step of the job, and restoreAt the step in the file of the action (the value of action.definition); none for a step of the job

summaries.name: CacheSave
summaries.doc: CacheSave is the summary of a step of actions/cache or actions/cache/save of a job that may save to the cache of the default branch's scope (actions/job): the references of its key and its path, and the events on which its job may save.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: actions/cache or actions/cache/save

fields.name: keyRefs
fields.doc: each ${{ }} reference in its key, and whether an attacker controls it

fields.name: pathRefs
fields.doc: each ${{ }} reference in its path, and whether an attacker controls it

fields.name: cacheWriteOn
fields.doc: the events on which its job may save to the cache of the default branch's scope, that the step's if lets through

fields.name: dispatchOn
fields.doc: the runs of workflow_dispatch on which its job may save to the cache of the scope of the ref that the one who dispatches the workflow chooses, that the step's if lets through

fields.name: cacheApproval
fields.doc: what makes a person approve the run on those events

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: the environment of the job, when the approval is ApprovalEnvironment

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of its labeled runs, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

summaries.name: CheckoutSite
summaries.doc: CheckoutSite is the summary of a step of actions/checkout that can run on a privileged event (actions/prcode): the code it brings, the guard of its release, the approval of its job, and the steps after it that run what it brings.

fields.name: checkoutCode
fields.doc: what code it brings

fields.name: refs
fields.doc: the references that make the tree a pull request's, the repository's first

fields.name: fork
fields.doc: whether the repository is the fork

fields.name: noRef
fields.doc: whether no ref is given

fields.name: inconclusiveValues
fields.doc: the values whose code is inconclusive by the tables, as written

fields.name: dynamic
fields.doc: whether with is a whole ${{ }}

fields.name: prCodeOn
fields.doc: the privileged events the step can run on

fields.name: dispatchOn
fields.doc: the runs of workflow_dispatch the step can run on

fields.name: dispatchInput
fields.doc: whether its ref or repository refers to an input of workflow_dispatch

fields.name: guard
fields.doc: whether its release refuses a fork's code

fields.name: sha
fields.doc: the commit it is pinned to, when the guard is GuardSHA

fields.name: approval
fields.doc: what makes a person approve the run

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: the environment of the job, when the approval is ApprovalEnvironment

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of its labeled runs, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: codeRunSteps
fields.doc: the steps after it that run what it brings

fields.name: cacheSaves
fields.doc: the steps that save what it brings to the cache

fields.name: unansweredCalls
fields.doc: the uses with no answer that someone asked could not give, on the way from the steps that may save what it brings to the cache, as cacheSaves reads them (actions/composite)

fields.name: cacheWriteOn
fields.doc: of prCodeOn, the events on which its job may save to the cache of the default branch's scope

fields.name: dispatchCacheOn
fields.doc: the runs of workflow_dispatch on which its job may save to the cache of the scope of the ref that the one who dispatches the workflow chooses, that the step's if lets through

fields.name: mutable
fields.doc: whether what it brings can move after the event

fields.name: stepPath
fields.doc: the step as a file of facts names it

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

fixes.name: BaseCheckout
fixes.doc: the fix that makes the checkout bring the base's code

fixes.name: PinHeadSHA
fixes.doc: the fix that makes the checkout bring the commit the approval saw, for the reference ref of Refs on events

summaries.name: CompositeCall
summaries.doc: CompositeCall is the summary of a step of a workflow or of a composite action that runs an action of the inputs or of another repository: the actions the step runs and their steps, to the depth composite.Reader reads (actions/composite), and the uses of other repositories on the way that action.definition does not answer.

handles.name: at
handles.doc: the uses of the step: where a finding of what the step runs is

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses of the step as written

fields.name: actions
fields.doc: the actions the step runs, in the order read (depth first, in the order of the steps)

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: the steps of the composite actions among them, in the same order

fields.name: unanswered
fields.doc: the uses of other repositories on the way that have no answer

fields.name: privilegedOn
fields.doc: the privileged events of an attacker the step can run on past the ifs of its job and its own (job.Privileged; of the callers when they decide them)

summaries.name: ConfigurationVariableRef
summaries.doc: ConfigurationVariableRef is the summary of a reference to a configuration variable by its name (vars.<name>, or vars['<name>']) in a ${{ }} of a workflow: how the ${{ }} uses the value, which is the empty string when no level defines the name, and the environments whose names of the environment level the place of the reference reads. The keys are those ExpressionMistake reads, the name of a step among them; an if of text and ${{ }} is not read (GitHub reads it as a text, which is true whatever the value), nor run-name of a workflow that runs only when called (GitHub names the run by the caller), nor a reference whose index is not a literal, nor the whole vars context.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: the name, as written

fields.name: expression
fields.doc: the ${{ }}, as written

fields.name: use
fields.doc: how the ${{ }} uses the value

fields.name: environments
fields.doc: the environments, each once and in order, whose names of the environment level the place of the reference may read: that of the job of the key; of every job of the workflow for a key outside the jobs; none for run-name, the if and the name of a job, which do not read the environment level

fields.name: environmentExpression
fields.doc: whether the environment of a job of environments is written with a ${{ }}, so that its name is not known

fields.name: remoteCallerOnly
fields.doc: whether the workflow runs on workflow_call only and no input calls it with ./ or $/: a caller of another repository decides the configuration variables

summaries.name: DependencyReviewStep
summaries.doc: DependencyReviewStep is the summary of a step of actions/dependency-review-action: the inputs that turn off what it checks or ask for a comment, and whether its job's GITHUB_TOKEN may write pull-requests.

handles.name: warnOnlyAt
handles.doc: the value of warn-only, else the step

handles.name: vulnerabilityCheckAt
handles.doc: the value of vulnerability-check, else the step

handles.name: licenseCheckAt
handles.doc: the value of license-check, else the step

handles.name: commentAt
handles.doc: the value of comment-summary-in-pr that asks for a comment, else the step

fields.name: warnOnly
fields.doc: warn-only, as the action reads it

fields.name: vulnerabilityCheck
fields.doc: vulnerability-check, as the action reads it

fields.name: licenseCheck
fields.doc: license-check, as the action reads it

fields.name: licensePolicy
fields.doc: whether allow-licenses or deny-licenses is written

fields.name: commentRequested
fields.doc: whether comment-summary-in-pr is always, on-failure or true

fields.name: pullRequestsWrite
fields.doc: whether the job's GITHUB_TOKEN may write pull-requests, by its permissions or the workflow's

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

summaries.name: DownloadSite
summaries.doc: DownloadSite is the summary of a step of actions/download-artifact or dawidd6/action-download-artifact that can run on a privileged event (actions/prcode): the run it takes, the token's scope, where it puts the files, and the steps after it that run them.

fields.name: prRunRefs
fields.doc: what makes it take an attacker's run

fields.name: sameRunUploads
fields.doc: the uploads of the current run that check out the code of a pull request, when it takes the current run

fields.name: inconclusiveValues
fields.doc: the inputs that decide the run whose analysis is inconclusive, as written

fields.name: dynamic
fields.doc: whether with is a whole ${{ }}

fields.name: prCodeOn
fields.doc: the privileged events it can run on, of those of its references

fields.name: dispatchOn
fields.doc: the runs of workflow_dispatch the step can run on

fields.name: dispatchInput
fields.doc: whether its run, repository, token or allow_forks refers to an input of workflow_dispatch

fields.name: approval
fields.doc: what makes a person approve the run

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: the environment of the job, when the approval is ApprovalEnvironment

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of its labeled runs, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: actionsRead
fields.doc: whether its token may read the artifacts of another run

fields.name: destination
fields.doc: where it puts the files

fields.name: destinationText
fields.doc: the path, when the destination is inconclusive, as written

fields.name: missingCommits
fields.doc: the commits its pinned commit has to lack for the reading to hold

fields.name: codeRunSteps
fields.doc: the steps after it that run what it puts

fields.name: stepPath
fields.doc: the step as a file of facts names it

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

fixes.name: RunnerTempPath
fixes.doc: the fix that puts the files under runner.temp: path ${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts in its with

summaries.name: EnvKey
summaries.doc: EnvKey is the summary of a key of env, of the workflow, a job or a step, of a job's container or a service, or of runs.env or a step of an action.yml, that does not set the variable it names: one with = in it, or one the runner writes over in every step (taint.RunnerVariable; not read for a service). A key with a ${{ }}, and an env that is a ${{ }}, are not summarized.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: the key, as written

fields.name: variable
fields.doc: the part of the key before its first =, which the runner sets instead; empty when the key has no =

fields.name: runnerValue
fields.doc: what the runner writes to the variable the key names: the ${{ }} of a context (${{ github.sha }}), or the text true; empty when the runner does not write it, or the key is written with that value

summaries.name: ExpressionMistake
summaries.doc: ExpressionMistake is the summary of a ${{ }}, of a workflow or an action.yml, that does not fit its key or fails when it runs (by the source of actions/runner at https://github.com/actions/runner/tree/397b032cbf865e9c3ddfab89d533ec19325e1273, read on 2026-10-21, and by runs observed on 2026-10-21, which alone show which forms keep a job from starting: lines 358-384 of src/Sdk/DTObjectTemplating/ObjectTemplating/TemplateEvaluator.cs check a literal that a ${{ }} written alone gives against the definition of its key, and other lines of the same directory check a mapping or a sequence it gives; src/Sdk/Expressions/Sdk/Functions/Format.cs, Case.cs and FromJson.cs fail when the number of a placeholder is not below the number of the arguments after the format string, when a predicate evaluated before the first true one is not a boolean, and when the argument made a string is no JSON, as an object made the string Object is not), by the types of the contexts where it is: a ${{ }} written alone as the value of a key, none of whose types the key takes; a call of format(), case() or fromJSON() that fails; or a ${{ }} in a text whose value is an object or an array, which the text holds as Object or Array (objectText). An if is read for its calls only (cond reads an if of text and ${{ }}), the name of a step for its text only (GitHub only warns when the name fails). A ${{ }} whose type is not known is not summarized.

handles.name: at
handles.doc: the ${{ }}, or the value it is written as

fields.name: expressionKey
fields.doc: the key; ExpressionKeyUnset for a ${{ }} in a text

fields.name: expression
fields.doc: the ${{ }}, as written

fields.name: error
fields.doc: why it fails; EvaluationErrorUnset for a ${{ }} in a text

fields.name: valueTypes
fields.doc: the types the value may be, for EvaluationErrorType and for a ${{ }} in a text; empty for the others

fields.name: objectText
fields.doc: whether it is a ${{ }} in a text whose value is an object or an array

summaries.name: IfSite
summaries.doc: IfSite is the summary of the if of a job or a step that an attacker's privileged event may run (actions/attacker): the events, and the comparisons of it that a run of Dependabot or a part of a string lets through.

fields.name: attackerOn
fields.doc: the privileged events the job or step may run on: those of the job that its if, read in the attacker runs, lets in (for a step), whose event and activity type the if allows

fields.name: dependabotBypasses
fields.doc: the comparisons a run of Dependabot lets through

fields.name: otherBots
fields.doc: the comparisons of an actor with another bot

fields.name: substringBypasses
fields.doc: the calls a part of a value passes

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of the labeled runs that its if guards, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fixes.name: AuthorContext
fixes.doc: the fix that compares the author of the pull request in place of the actor, of the bypass i of DependabotBypasses

fixes.name: ContainsArray
fixes.doc: the fix that compares the words of the string as an array, of the bypass i of SubstringBypasses

fixes.name: Equality
fixes.doc: the fix that compares the reference with the whole string by ==, of the bypass i of SubstringBypasses whose reference is the first argument

summaries.name: ImageSite
summaries.doc: ImageSite is the summary of a place that names an image to run: a job's container or service, a step's uses: docker://, or an action.yml's runs.image: docker://. An image whose digest docker refuses is not among its images: it is never pulled.

fields.name: site
fields.doc: what the place is

fields.name: serviceName
fields.doc: the name of the service, when the place is one

fields.name: images
fields.doc: the images it may run

fields.name: inconclusiveImages
fields.doc: the images it may run that are inconclusive

summaries.name: Job
summaries.doc: Job is the summary of a job of a workflow (actions/job): the attacker's privileged events it can run on, what approves it, whether its GITHUB_TOKEN may write and where write-all holds for it, the secrets it reads, the reusable workflow it calls, the labels of its runs-on, and the events on which its cache-mode lets it save to the cache.

handles.name: cacheModeAt
handles.doc: the cache-mode that lets it save to the cache, the job's or the workflow's, else the job

fields.name: privilegedOn
fields.doc: the attacker's privileged events it can run on

fields.name: approval
fields.doc: what makes a person approve the run

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: the environment, when the approval is ApprovalEnvironment

fields.name: automaticApproval
fields.doc: of its labeled runs, how a step of the repository that runs actions/labeler lets the attacker in

fields.name: tokenWrite
fields.doc: whether its GITHUB_TOKEN may write

fields.name: writeAll
fields.doc: where write-all holds for its GITHUB_TOKEN: its permissions, else the workflow's

fields.name: calledOnly
fields.doc: whether its workflow has no event but workflow_call: only a caller runs it, or nothing does (on: {} or no on)

fields.name: inheritSecrets
fields.doc: whether it calls a reusable workflow with secrets: inherit

fields.name: calledKind
fields.doc: where the reusable workflow it calls is

fields.name: calledRepo
fields.doc: owner/name of the reusable workflow it calls, for one of another repository

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: its uses as written

fields.name: secrets
fields.doc: the secrets it reads

fields.name: calledContextReads
fields.doc: for a job that calls a reusable workflow whose contents the linter has: the ${{ }} of that workflow, or of one it calls in turn, whose reads of the secrets context name no secret and make the job read every secret

fields.name: runnerLabels
fields.doc: the labels of its runs-on

fields.name: inconclusiveLabels
fields.doc: the labels of its runs-on that are inconclusive

fields.name: cacheWriteOn
fields.doc: the attacker's privileged events on which it may save to the cache of the default branch's scope: by its cache-mode, on its events and on those of its callers that write none

fields.name: cacheApproval
fields.doc: what makes a person approve the run on the events of cacheWriteOn

fields.name: cacheModeText
fields.doc: the cache-mode that lets it save, as written

fields.name: calledCacheModes
fields.doc: for a job that writes no cache-mode and calls a reusable workflow of another repository (workflow.definition): the jobs of that workflow whose cache-mode, else their workflow's, saves, which let the job save; cacheModeAt is then the uses of the job

fields.name: calledUnanswered
fields.doc: for a job that writes no cache-mode and calls a reusable workflow of another repository: the call when workflow.definition has no answer for it

fixes.name: CacheModeNoWrite
fixes.doc: the fix that makes its cache-mode one that does not save: write becomes read, write-only none

summaries.name: JobTimeout
summaries.doc: JobTimeout is the summary of a job that runs on a runner (not one that calls a reusable workflow): whether it writes timeout-minutes.

fields.name: written
fields.doc: whether it writes timeout-minutes, a value or a ${{ }}

fields.name: job
fields.doc: the job's ID

summaries.name: LeftCredential
summaries.doc: LeftCredential is a credential a step before an upload left in a file that an upload takes (actions/artifact), once however many uploads take it: an upload names it by its index (TakenCredential). Its key is the step's; a step that leaves two files has two.

fields.name: file
fields.doc: where it is left

fields.name: lifetime
fields.doc: how long it works

fields.name: missingCommits
fields.doc: of the step's pin

fields.name: checkout
fields.doc: whether the step is actions/checkout

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses of the step, as written

fixes.name: PersistCredentialsFalse
fixes.doc: the fix that keeps the credential out of .git/config: persist-credentials false on its checkout

summaries.name: MixedIf
summaries.doc: MixedIf is the summary of an if, of a job or a step of a workflow or of a step of a composite action, that GitHub reads as a string (workflow.IfMixed): text outside its ${{ }}, or more than one ${{ }}.

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: the value of the if, as written

fields.name: statusFunctions
fields.doc: the status functions that an expression of its ${{ }} calls, in the order of the if, once each: with one, the runner does not add success() &&

summaries.name: NodeRuntimeSetting
summaries.doc: NodeRuntimeSetting is the summary of a key of env, of the workflow, a job or a step, that names a setting of the Node.js runtime of actions: ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION or FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE20, compared without case.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: the key as written

summaries.name: PrintedOutput
summaries.doc: PrintedOutput is a ${{ }} of a step's env, with or name, or of a job's env, that reads an output whose value the shell made from a secret: the runner prints the value in the header of the step (actions/taint).

fields.name: secret
fields.doc: the secret's name as written; empty for the job's token

fields.name: token
fields.doc: the job's token

fields.name: transform
fields.doc: how the shell changed the value: the operator of an expansion, or the command

fields.name: text
fields.doc: the ${{ }} as written

summaries.name: RegistryCredentials
summaries.doc: RegistryCredentials is the summary of the credentials of a job's container or service that have a password.

fields.name: passwordForm
fields.doc: whether the password is written in the workflow, read from secrets, or read from another context

fields.name: passwordText
fields.doc: the password as written, for the note of an inconclusive one

fields.name: container
fields.doc: container, or services.<name>

summaries.name: RemoteCall
summaries.doc: RemoteCall is the summary of a job of a workflow that calls a reusable workflow of another repository: the workflows it calls, to the depth composite.Reader.ExpandCall reads (workflow.definition), their jobs and the steps of those, and the calls on the way that workflow.definition does not answer.

handles.name: at
handles.doc: the uses of the job: where a finding of what the job calls is

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses of the job as written

fields.name: jobs
fields.doc: the jobs of the workflows called, in the order read (depth first, in the order of the jobs)

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: the steps of those jobs, in the same order; Query is the workflow.definition of the file

fields.name: unanswered
fields.doc: the calls on the way that have no answer

fields.name: called
fields.doc: the workflows called, as read, for the analyses of this package

summaries.name: RequestActionSite
summaries.doc: RequestActionSite is the summary of an input of a step of an action that sends its credential where the input says (actions/taint): the scanner of SonarSource's actions and octokit/request-action.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: owner/repo of the action

fields.name: input
fields.doc: the name of the input

fields.name: hostRefs
fields.doc: the ${{ }} references in it that can decide the host the action sends to, and whether an attacker controls each

fields.name: pathRefs
fields.doc: the other ${{ }} references in it: after the host of a route or a URL

fields.name: secrets
fields.doc: the secrets the action reads its credential from: of env and with

fields.name: runnerHosting
fields.doc: who runs the machine of its job; unknown in an action.yml

fields.name: runnerLabels
fields.doc: the labels of the job's runs-on, as written

summaries.name: RunsUsingSite
summaries.doc: RunsUsingSite is the summary of the runs.using of an action.yml.

fields.name: using
fields.doc: runs.using as written

summaries.name: SecretPart
summaries.doc: SecretPart is a ${{ }} whose value has a value taken out of a secret by fromJSON, which the runner does not mask, where the runner prints it in the log (actions/job).

fields.name: secrets
fields.doc: the names of the secrets it is taken out of; * for one not named

fields.name: via
fields.doc: the outputs of the jobs that the value comes through by needs, nearest first

fields.name: text
fields.doc: the ${{ }} as written

summaries.name: SecretsContextRead
summaries.doc: SecretsContextRead is a ${{ }} with a reference that reads the secrets context and names no secret, for which GitHub sends the job every secret (actions/job); and, of a workflow that only a caller runs, its callers.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: the reference as written, the first if it has several

fields.name: calledOnly
fields.doc: whether its workflow has no event but workflow_call

fields.name: callerCoverage
fields.doc: how much of the callers of its workflow the inputs have

fields.name: inheritCallers
fields.doc: the jobs of the inputs that call its workflow with secrets: inherit

summaries.name: SetupNodeVersion
summaries.doc: SetupNodeVersion is the summary of the node-version of a step of actions/setup-node that has no ${{ }}: the Node.js the steps after it build and test with.

fields.name: nodeVersion
fields.doc: node-version as written

summaries.name: Sink
summaries.doc: Sink is the summary of a run of a step, or the script of actions/github-script, and what an attacker controls in it (actions/taint).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: a run or a script

fields.name: refs
fields.doc: each ${{ }} reference in it, and whether an attacker controls it

fields.name: environmentFileWrites
fields.doc: what it writes to a file command of the runner

fields.name: inconclusiveWrites
fields.doc: the writes to an environment file whose analysis is inconclusive

fields.name: arguments
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, the words of its commands with a value an attacker may control in them

fields.name: requests
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, the requests its commands send: curl, wget, gh api

fields.name: secretLeaks
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, where it prints a value it made from a secret

fields.name: unsecureFlag
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS in the env context of its step

fields.name: unsecureFlagPlace
fields.doc: where the flag is set

fields.name: hasStepId
fields.doc: whether the step has an id: the runner keeps the outputs of a step only when the step has an id

fields.name: hasStepAfter
fields.doc: whether a step of the job, or of the action, starts after the step is done; a step of the same parallel group does not

fields.name: variableCodes
fields.doc: for a run of bash, the variables of env whose value an attacker may control and that it reads as code

fields.name: logWrites
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh whose flag may be true with a step after it, or whose step has an id, the references an attacker may control it prints to its log

fields.name: authoredCommands
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, the workflow commands set-output, save-state, set-env and add-path whose names are in its text and that it prints to its log

fields.name: callsNotRead
fields.doc: for a run of bash or sh, none, or the first call of a function whose body the readings of the run did not read past their limit of calls

fixes.name: RefFix
fixes.doc: what the fix of its step gives the reference i of Refs

fixes.name: WriteFix
fixes.doc: what the fix of its step gives the write i of EnvironmentFileWrites: that of its reference, or of its variable

summaries.name: StepFix
summaries.doc: StepFix is the fix of a step whose run or script has what an attacker controls: one plan for the step, which every rule that reports in it gives.

fields.name: plan
fields.doc: what each place of the step gets

summaries.name: Upload
summaries.doc: Upload is the summary of a step of actions/upload-artifact and the credentials it puts in its artifact (actions/artifact).

handles.name: pathAt
handles.doc: the path of its with, else the step: where a finding of it is

fields.name: takenCredentials
fields.doc: the credentials the steps before it left that it takes, as indices of the LeftCredentials of the IR, compared by place: an index moves when a LeftCredential before it goes

fields.name: hiddenMissingCommits
fields.doc: the commits the pin of its release lacks when the release takes hidden files: the condition of a TakenCredential whose Hidden is set

fields.name: downloadableDuringRun
fields.doc: whether others can download the artifact while the run goes on

fields.name: tokenWrite
fields.doc: whether the job's GITHUB_TOKEN may write

fields.name: inconclusive
fields.doc: the inputs it and the steps before it have whose analysis is inconclusive

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

summaries.name: Uses
summaries.doc: Uses is the summary of a uses that names another repository: a job's (a reusable workflow), or a step's of a workflow or of a composite action. A uses folded from a literal is one when what it folds to is.

handles.name: refAt
handles.doc: the ref in the uses: where a finding of it is, and what a pin replaces

handles.name: pathAt
handles.doc: the path in the uses, as written: where a finding of the action is that a path above the root of the repository names; the ref when the uses has no path

fields.name: repo
fields.doc: owner/repo as written

fields.name: path
fields.doc: the path of the action or the reusable workflow that runs, in its repository, after owner/repo/, as GitHub reads it (empty parts dropped, . and .. resolved); empty when it is at the root or when the uses goes above the root of its repository

fields.name: ref
fields.doc: the ref as written, after @

fields.name: exact
fields.doc: whether the ref is written as it reads, with no escape, so that a fix can write in its place

fields.name: level
fields.doc: whether it is a job's or a step's

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

fields.name: folded
fields.doc: whether the uses is folded from a ${{ }} literal, which the update tools do not read as a uses

fields.name: lineComment
fields.doc: the text of the comment at the end of the line the uses ends on, after the # and without the white space around it; empty without one

fields.name: outside
fields.doc: whether the path goes above the root of the repository with ..: the runner downloads owner/repo at the ref, and runs an action of another directory of its directory of actions

fields.name: runActions
fields.doc: when outside and no other uses of the same steps downloads the action that runs: each reading of that action, as owner/repo@ref; empty otherwise

fields.name: runUses
fields.doc: each reading of the action or the reusable workflow that runs, as owner/repo[/path]@ref with the path as the runner reads it (empty parts dropped, . and .. resolved): the readings of Runs of workflow.Uses: one when the path stays in its repository; when the path goes above the root of its repository, the one that another uses of the same steps downloads, or else every reading; none when the path goes above the directory of actions

fields.name: readByOutside
fields.doc: whether another uses of the same steps goes above the root of its repository into the directory of this uses, so that pinning this ref leaves that uses with no action

summaries.name: UsesPathSite
summaries.doc: UsesPathSite is the summary of a step's uses (of another repository, ./ or $/) that GitHub does not read as written: one with parts that GitHub drops or resolves, or whose path goes with .. above its root.

fields.name: usesText
fields.doc: the uses as written

fields.name: normalized
fields.doc: the uses as GitHub reads it; empty when outside

fields.name: form
fields.doc: how the uses is written apart from how GitHub reads it
